// The deployment identity and current authenticated user are server values.
// This is transport admission, never a certificate or a browser capability.

required(object(user) && user.role === 'admin' && user.is_active === true && UUID.test(user.id || '') &&
    same(user.tenant_id, env.MYTMS_OFFICE_AGENCY_ID), 'CORRECTION_ACTOR_NOT_ALLOWED', 403);
